projects.title: Udhyog Saathi
projects.subtitle: Business Operating System for Manufacturers
projects.shortDescription: A specialized SaaS platform engineered for small and mid-sized manufacturing enterprises, centralizing dual-mode invoicing, raw-material inventory, worker operations, and real-time production analytics.
projects.cardDescription: Turning traditional manufacturing into a digital system.
projects.overview: Small and mid-sized manufacturers in India often manage mission-critical operations with fragmented paper slips, physical ledgers, and informal WhatsApp chats. Udhyog Saathi replaces disjointed tracking with a single intuitive operational workspace.
projects.problem: Manual double-entry errors in invoicing, sudden stockouts of raw materials without warning, lack of worker attendance and payout accountability, and zero visibility into daily production output.
projects.solution: A full-stack web operating system designed specifically around Indian manufacturing workflows—including support for Kacha and Pakka bill formats, real-time inventory threshold alerts, and mobile-friendly workforce dashboards.
features: Executive operational dashboard summarizing active orders, revenue, and material levels
Dual-mode invoice generation supporting flexible business compliance requirements
Real-time raw material and finished inventory tracking with automated stock warnings
Worker management module for tracking shifts, task completions, and wage disbursements
Production line throughput analytics to uncover bottleneck operations

architecture.description: Decoupled React client communicating with a resilient Express REST service backed by MongoDB document stores for dynamic invoice schemas.

projects.myContribution: Architected the frontend UI with React and Tailwind CSS, structured the operational data models in MongoDB, built RESTful endpoints in Express, and designed the intuitive invoice and inventory creation flows.
outcomes: Eliminated manual paper ledgers across regional manufacturing plants.
Prevented production halts with automatic stock threshold warnings.
Reduced invoice preparation time from 15 minutes to under 2 minutes.

projects.title: InsightLoop
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Business Intelligence Platform
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack operational intelligence platform tracking multi-stream sales, worker payouts, and profit-and-loss margins via a synchronized live dashboard and integrated AI assistant.
projects.cardDescription: Real-time business intelligence and multi-stream analytics.
projects.overview: InsightLoop is an operational command center built to turn high-velocity transactional data into clear business decisions, providing operators with immediate clarity into their cash position and team performance.
projects.problem: Business owners frequently spend hours each evening compiling disparate receipts and cash transactions to calculate whether they made a profit or loss on any given day.
projects.solution: A reactive dashboard that automatically ingests sales streams, calculates wage deductions, and visualizes true net operating margins in real time with WebSocket updates.
features: Real-time revenue and margin calculation ticker across active business operations
Dynamic data visualization components mapping cash flows and labor expenditures
Integrated AI analytical assistant answering ad-hoc queries regarding operational metrics
Exportable balance sheets and compliance ready transaction summaries
Multi-device responsive layout optimized for high density tablet and desktop views

architecture.description: Event-driven architecture with bidirectional WebSocket synchronization for instant dashboard state updates across active browser clients.

projects.myContribution: Engineered the entire system solo—from drafting the data pipelines in MongoDB and configuring WebSocket broadcast channels to developing the component library with custom charting in React.
outcomes: Sub-second latency on multi-stream cash event updates.
Direct Vercel deployment serving instantaneous operational summaries.

projects.title: LUCID: The Living Dream
projects.subtitle: Persistent Virtual Universe & First-Person 3D Spaceflight
projects.shortDescription: A browser-based persistent 3D virtual universe featuring first-person manual spacecraft flight, physical orbital navigation HUDs, atmospheric landing, and surface exploration across 10 distinct worlds.
projects.cardDescription: First-person WebGL spaceflight, orbital physics, and planetary exploration.
projects.overview: LUCID is a browser-playable prototype testing the engineering limits of interconnected 3D virtual worlds. Rather than opening static 2D menus, players awaken directly inside an articulated spacecraft cockpit with 360° continuous yaw/pitch steering, vector guidance HUDs, velocity particle streaks, planetary approach turbulence, and surface touchdown across a charted multiverse.
projects.problem: Traditional web-based virtual experiences are either static 3D model viewers or fragmented into disconnected page reloads with poor physics and sluggish frame rates.
projects.solution: Engineered a low-latency 3D simulation using React Three Fiber, custom shaders, decoupled orbital physics, inertia-preserving particle streaks, an interactive 10-step flight tutorial, and a resilient Socket.IO multiplayer gateway.
features: First-person 3D spacecraft cockpit with 360° steering, manual throttle, retro-braking, and ion boost
Vector flight guidance HUD with drift telemetry, off-screen steering cues, and 2D tactical radar
10 charted planetary worlds with celestial suns, atmospheric sky domes, and procedural terrain
Atmospheric descent, surface touchdown on landing pads, and pointer-locked first-person exploration
Interactive 10-step flight tutorial and 3-tier autopilot assist modes

architecture.description: Modular Three.js / React Three Fiber scene hierarchy with Zustand state orchestration for flight controls, decoupled from a Node.js/Socket.IO presence server with MongoDB Atlas telemetry.

projects.myContribution: Built the entire first-person flight camera and physics calculations, engineered the custom HUD vector reticle and 2D tactical radar, implemented planetary sky domes and terrain shaders, and wrote automated flight test suites.
outcomes: Smooth 60 FPS flight simulation and orbital transitions entirely in client browser.
Complete 10-step pilot onboarding flow with automatic control detection and recovery autopilot.

projects.title: AlphaVault
projects.subtitle: High-Performance Financial Analytics & Transaction Engine
projects.shortDescription: A high-performance financial analytics and transaction management interface architected with React 19, Three.js 3D card tilt shaders, TanStack Query & Table, and Playwright end-to-end test automation.
projects.cardDescription: High-volume transaction management and interactive financial analytics.
projects.overview: AlphaVault is engineered as an enterprise-grade fintech frontend capable of seamlessly exploring and analyzing large-scale transaction datasets with sub-millisecond client responsiveness and interactive 3D interactions.
projects.problem: Fintech web interfaces frequently degrade under heavy transaction volumes, causing UI freezing, sluggish sorting, broken URL state synchronization, and lack of visual feedback.
projects.solution: Implemented a strict feature-sliced architecture with server-side pagination/filtering/sorting over 10,000+ transaction datasets, debounced search, Recharts category breakdowns, interactive 3D perspective tilts, and automated Playwright E2E coverage.
features: Feature-based domain isolation: Auth, Transactions, Analytics, and Rewards modules
Server-side debounced search, multi-column sorting, and pagination via TanStack Table
Interactive category spending trends and monthly outflow comparisons with Recharts
Interactive 3D card tilt and glow shaders built with Three.js and Postprocessing
Automated end-to-end regression validation with Playwright and Vitest

architecture.description: Unidirectional data flow from URL state parameters to TanStack Query caches, driving virtualized TanStack Tables and Recharts visualization components.

projects.myContribution: Architected the domain feature boundaries, developed the transaction data table with server-state caching, integrated interactive 3D marketing components, and created comprehensive Playwright tests.
outcomes: Instantaneous URL-synchronized filtering across thousands of records without memory leaks.
Complete test automation across critical transaction and authentication user journeys.

projects.title: Parallel
projects.subtitle: Identity-First Collaborative Social Network
projects.shortDescription: A multi-dimensional social platform allowing individuals to construct distinct personas, partition audience circles, and engage in real-time topic spaces with high-throughput messaging.
projects.cardDescription: A social identity platform to explore different versions of yourself.
projects.overview: Traditional social networks force users into a single homogenous profile where professional updates, creative hobbies, and casual banter collide awkwardly.
projects.problem: Context collapse across personal and professional personas, lack of granular audience segmentation, and lagging chat interactions during peak usage.
projects.solution: An identity-discovery platform featuring sub-profile switching, channel-based discussions, and an asynchronous task queue architecture powered by NestJS and Redis.
features: Multi-identity account switching with distinct handle and privacy controls
Live discussion channels with low-latency messaging via Socket.IO
Asynchronous background notification and digest processing using BullMQ
Relational data model in PostgreSQL orchestrated by Prisma with strict migrations
Modern Next.js App Router client with responsive Tailwind UI

architecture.description: Next.js frontend leveraging React Server Components connected to a NestJS Fastify backend with Redis-backed BullMQ job pipelines and PostgreSQL document storage.

projects.myContribution: Implemented the NestJS API gateway, designed the relational schema with Prisma migrations, wired real-time event emitters via WebSockets, and implemented client-side state with Zustand.
outcomes: Decoupled identity data model supporting isolated persona interactions.
Reliable message delivery with background queue worker offloading.

projects.title: MERN Starter Pack
projects.subtitle: Production-Ready TypeScript Full-Stack Monorepo
projects.shortDescription: A production-grade, TypeScript-first MERN monorepo template with React 19, Express 5, MongoDB 8, HTTP-only refresh-token rotation, Vitest/Supertest test suites, and Docker Compose.
projects.cardDescription: Production-ready MERN monorepo with enterprise JWT authentication.
projects.overview: A hardened application boilerplate designed to eliminate repetitive full-stack setup while baking in production standards for authentication, input validation, structured logging, and containerized development.
projects.problem: Most MERN starters rely on outdated dependencies, store JWT tokens insecurely in localStorage, lack request validation schemas, and omit automated test pipelines.
projects.solution: Engineered a TypeScript monorepo with strict Zod runtime schemas, short-lived JWT access tokens with secure HTTP-only refresh cookie rotation, Express 5 middleware (Helmet, CORS, Pino), Docker Compose MongoDB 8 healthchecks, and Vitest/Supertest suites.
features: Enterprise authentication flow: registration, login, short-lived JWT access, and refresh rotation
Node.js Express 5 backend with ES modules, Zod validation, and Pino structured logging
React 19 frontend with TanStack Query, React Hook Form, and protected route wrappers
Multi-container local development via Docker Compose with persistent MongoDB 8 volumes
Comprehensive automated test suites covering API schemas, controllers, and frontend UI

architecture.description: pnpm monorepo structure separating client (React 19/Vite 7) and server (Express 5/Mongoose) with unified linting, formatting, and Docker Compose orchestration.

projects.myContribution: Designed the dual-token JWT auth architecture with cryptographic cookie rotation, configured the monorepo workspace scripts, built the Zod request validation pipeline, and authored the documentation.
outcomes: Zero-configuration local setup with single command Docker Compose environment.
Security-hardened authentication preventing XSS token exfiltration.

projects.title: HotReload
projects.subtitle: High-Performance Go Process Supervisor
projects.shortDescription: A developer tool engineered in Go providing instant file system watching via OS-native kqueue/inotify calls and sub-millisecond process restart cycles.
projects.cardDescription: Sub-millisecond process supervisor and file-watcher written in Go.
projects.overview: A lightweight terminal utility built for software developers tired of sluggish Node-based file watchers consuming gigabytes of memory during continuous integration and local compilation loops.
projects.problem: Standard language-agnostic file watchers are often bloated Node.js scripts that introduce high CPU overhead and inconsistent debouncing delays on file save events.
projects.solution: Implemented a compiled Go binary utilizing low-level operating system notification hooks with concurrent event throttling and graceful PID teardown.
features: Native kqueue and inotify monitoring bypassing wasteful directory polling loops
Sub-2ms debounce detection and instantaneous child process restarts
Graceful SIGINT and SIGTERM cascade to avoid orphaned port allocations
Configurable file exclusion patterns and directory whitelist filtering
Zero-dependency single static binary release ready for developer path

architecture.description: Concurrent event loop matching OS-level file modification signals through buffered Go channels straight to process supervisory routines.

projects.myContribution: Wrote the core watcher logic in Go, handled POSIX process signal propagation, optimized event batching channels, and validated memory benchmarks across macOS and Linux.
outcomes: Reduced local development reload times from ~450ms to imperceptible instantaneous restart.
Completely prevented orphaned background Node and Go processes on crashed runs.

projects.title: Job Search Tracker
projects.subtitle: Multi-Platform Job Search & Recruitment Pipeline Tracker
projects.shortDescription: An automated job search scraper and recruitment pipeline tracker aggregating openings across multiple platforms with Google Sheets API synchronization and a mobile-friendly Flask dashboard.
projects.cardDescription: Automated multi-platform job aggregation and recruitment pipeline tracking.
projects.overview: A productivity tool that unifies job and internship searching across platforms (Indeed, LinkedIn, Internshala, Naukri, Wellfound) and synchronizes candidate pipeline progression into a single master tracker.
projects.problem: Job seekers lose track of applications across dozens of job boards, repeatedly re-searching identical keywords and struggling to maintain status notes in disjointed spreadsheets.
projects.solution: Built a Python orchestration engine that executes keyword/location queries across platforms, extracts listings, deduplicates links, syncs bidirectionally with Google Sheets API, and exposes a mobile web dashboard for instant status updates.
features: Multi-platform search aggregation across 7 major employment and internship portals
Automated link deduplication preventing redundant application entries
Bidirectional cloud synchronization with Google Sheets API and local CSV fallback
Mobile-responsive Flask web dashboard for updating interview stages and compensation
CLI command interface for head-less scheduled execution and pipeline status reports

architecture.description: Modular scraper plugins coordinated by JobAutomationSystem orchestrator, writing through an abstract storage layer supporting Google Sheets API service accounts and local CSVs.

projects.myContribution: Developed the scraper parsers, implemented Google Cloud service account authentication, built the local CSV fallback layer, and created the lightweight Flask web dashboard.
outcomes: Consolidated fragmented application tracking into a single automated pipeline.
Eliminated repetitive manual copying of job links and applicant notes.
